claims: - **Triton.** Plumes were seen on the southern cap near the subsolar latitude of the 1989 flyby. Dark fans across the cap are taken as deposits of earlier plumes (Hofgartner et al. 2022).

…ible. One is the solar-powered solid-state greenhouse, and two draw on internal heat. Hofgartner et al. (2022) argue that the plume and fan locations are not strong evidence for the solar model, and propose five remote-sensing tests.
